narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Grok PreToolUse wrapper command uses repo-root path; Grok resolves relative to .grok/hooks/ and doubles it

## Context

Consumer llmz on @deftai/directive 0.126.0 / engine 0.126.0. Path B / Prefer-A Bound #5656 deposits GROK_PRETOOLUSE_WRAPPER_REL_PATH into .grok/hooks/deft.json PreToolUse command. Observed in visionik/llmz during foundation land; session hook_execution updates show project/deft PreToolUse failing every Shell matcher.

## Expected behavior

Grok PreToolUse command for the outer-deny wrapper should resolve to <project>/.grok/hooks/deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh (beside deft.json), matching Grok hooks docs: relative commands resolve against the JSON file directory. nestedToolCommand should deposit a basename or ./deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh for host===grok tool.before while still writing the script file at .grok/hooks/deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh.

## Actual behavior / gap

nestedToolCommand returns GROK_PRETOOLUSE_WRAPPER_REL_PATH = ".grok/hooks/deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh" and writeAgentHookDeposit writes that string into deft.json command. Grok joins it under the hooks dir → <project>/.grok/hooks/.grok/hooks/deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh → command not found. Real file is <project>/.grok/hooks/deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh. Introduced in 0.126 deposit (consumer commit f30bc9c chore/directive-0.126.0). Session kept failing after stash restored bare deft-hook because hooks load at session start.

## Session notes

Repro: deposit 0.126 Grok hooks; inspect PreToolUse command; start Grok session; any run_terminal_command. Evidence: updates.jsonl project/deft pre_tool_use failed error command not found doubled path. Grok docs 10-hooks.md: relative to the JSON file. Fix: keep file write at GROK_PRETOOLUSE_WRAPPER_REL_PATH; change nestedToolCommand grok/tool.before return to GROK_PRETOOLUSE_WRAPPER_MARKER or ./ + marker. Claude-style root-relative paths remain wrong for Grok command field.

## Adoption impact

This report is a consumer hard-stop: the consumer cannot complete an intended Directive flow and has no reasonable workaround.

Title token: `BLOCKER`. This token does not apply the `adoption-blocker` ranking label. A privileged actor applies that label after the body-evidence test.

### Affected consumer flow and version

Grok Build PreToolUse outer-deny (#5656 Prefer-A Bound) on consumer @deftai/directive@0.126.0

### Documented alternatives attempted

Hand-edit deft.json command to basename deft-pretooluse-wrapper.sh; or revert PreToolUse to bare deft-hook (loses outer-deny); or deft policy:disable-host-hooks --host grok --confirm (disables Grok host hooks). None preserve deposited #5656 outer-deny without manual edit.

### Observed recovery cost

Every Grok PreToolUse Shell/Write matcher fails open or skips outer-deny until session restart after hand-edit; blocks trustworthy fail-closed mutation gating on Grok for 0.126 consumers.

### Triage owner and date

Scott (MScottAdams), 2026-10-18
